jobs.occupation: ESG & Impact Officer - International Exposure - Brussels
jobs.description:
The hiring company is a medium-sized organization within the financial services sector, specializing in banking and financial services. It is known for its focus on innovation, sustainability, and delivering impactful solutions for its stakeholders

Jobomschrijving

As an ESG & Impact Officer your responsibilities are:

• Conduct ESG and impact due diligence for high-risk investments
• Assess projects across sectors such as infrastructure, mining, agriculture, forestry, and financial services
• Manage external ESG and environmental & social consultants
• Support portfolio companies in implementing ESG management systems and action plans

• Contribute to impact reporting, case studies, and stakeholder communications

A successful ESG & Impact Officer should have:

• Strong experience applying IFC Performance Standards
• Direct contacts with companies
• Exposure to projects in emerging and developing markets

• Advanced Excel and data analysis skills; Power BI experience is a plus
• Ability to draft high-quality analytical reports and investment documentation in English

Our client is an international organisation headquartered in Brussels, bringing together members and stakeholders from across Europe. A successful Project Officer should have:

• Strong organisational skills with a high level of accuracy and attention to detail.
• Confident user of Microsoft Office applications, including Excel.
• Excellent communication skills in English, both written and verbal.
• Able to prioritise workloads, manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines.

• Minimum 5 years of professional experience in strategy, consulting, business analysis, project management, transformation or change management
• Strong understanding of the Life Insurance sector, including products, regulations and market dynamics

• Excellent analytical skills with the ability to translate complex data into actionable recommendations
• Strong financial acumen with experience in budgeting, financial analysis and management reporting

jobs.occupation: Finance Officer – Financial Control, Reporting & Process Improvement
jobs.description:
As a Finance Officer, you join the Administration Division of an international intergovernmental organisation promoting free trade and economic integration. You take hands-on responsibility for financial control and reporting while leading initiatives to improve administrative and financial processes.
 

You report directly to the Head of Finance and work within a four-person finance team. The department manages the organisation’s finances across offices in Brussels, Luxembourg and Geneva, as well as its Financial Mechanism Office.
 

This position is exclusively open to nationals of Iceland, Liechtenstein, Norway and Switzerland. The starting date is as soon as possible and no later than 1 March 2027. The application deadline is 18 October 2026.
 

Je verantwoordelijkheden:
 
 

• Preparing financial reports and analyses. 

• Performing accounting controls. 

• Coordinating the year-end closing process. 

• Managing projects to improve business processes within the Administration Division. 

• Overseeing procurement activities. 

• Overseeing contract management. 

• Overseeing travel management. 

• Acting as Head of Finance when required. 
 

• Nationality of Iceland, Liechtenstein, Norway or Switzerland is an essential eligibility requirement. 

• A master’s degree in business administration, finance, accounting or another relevant field is required. 

• At least five years of relevant experience in financial management, accounting, controlling, audit and/or consulting provides the necessary professional foundation. 

• A solid understanding of accounting, controlling and reporting is essential. 

• Practical experience with at least one accounting software package is required. 

• Excellent command of MS Excel supports your daily work. 

• Fluency in written and spoken English is essential. 

• A structured and analytical mindset characterises your approach. 

• Strong interpersonal skills allow you to collaborate effectively with colleagues. 

• You demonstrate commitment, motivation and initiative. 

• At least two years of consulting experience is an advantage. 

• Experience with payroll and public procurement would be an asset. 

• Knowledge of MS Dynamics 365 Finance and Power BI, including Power Query and Power Pivot, offers added value. 

• Experience as an IT systems superuser and/or with systems implementation is an advantage. 

• Project management experience and the ability to lead business improvement processes are valuable. 

• Previous work in an international environment is a plus. 

• Self-reliance, autonomy and a proactive approach complete your profile.

Our client is an international organisation operating within the consumer goods and retail sector.

Jobomschrijving

Key Responsibilities

• Participate in purchasing and commercial projects with a focus on value creation and business performance.
• Coordinate and facilitate discussions between various stakeholders to ensure successful project execution.
• Support negotiations, prepare relevant documentation and follow up on agreed actions.
• Analyse data and market insights to identify trends, opportunities and areas for improvement.

Successful Candidate Profile

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business, Procurement, Supply Chain, Marketing, or a related field.
• 2-5 years of experience in procurement, purchasing, FMCG, retail, category management, account management, commercial, or project management roles.
• Strong business acumen with an interest in purchasing, negotiations, and strategic stakeholder management.
• Excellent communication and influencing skills, with the ability to build credibility and manage multiple stakeholders.
• Advanced Excel skills and a data-driven mindset.
• Pragmatic, proactive, relationship-oriented, and comfortable operating in an international environment.
• Fluent in French and English; additional languages such as Dutch or German are a plus.

Jobomschrijving

• Keep freight shipments moving smoothly and on schedule

jobs.occupation: Strategic Pricing and Tender Management Specialist - Medtech
jobs.description:
Our client is an international healthcare business experiencing strong growth across global markets. The organization combines entrepreneurial agility with the resources and career opportunities of a multinational environment.

Jobomschrijving

As a successful Medical Devices - Pricing Strategy & Tender Management Specialist - UK & Ireland, your responsibilities are:

• Lead end-to-end tender management processes across the UK & Ireland markets
• Manage Tenders submission with local Authorities from UK & Ireland (NHS & HSE)
• Develop and recommend commercial pricing strategies based on market analysis & pricing benchmark
• Perform profitability and financial analyses to support Tender, Contracts and Bids

• Experience managing complex tenders and commercial contracts

• Fluent English communication skills

Our client is a well-established international organization operating within a complex retail and logistics environment. Technology plays a central role in supporting business operations, and the company is investing in delivering a high-quality IT support experience to its internal users.The position is based in the Dilbeek area.

As an IT Service Desk Support Specialist, your responsibilities will include:

• Acting as the first point of contact for IT incidents and service requests.
• Logging, categorizing, prioritizing, and managing tickets through the ITSM platform.
• Performing first-line troubleshooting and resolving technical issues whenever possible.
• Supporting end-user devices, including laptops, desktops, printers, scanners, mobile devices, and standard business applications.

jobs.occupation: Senior Accountant in Brussels - International company

jobs.description:
You will work in Ninove, in a modern and highly automated environment specialized in logistics automation and automated warehouse systems.

The company develops, integrates and maintains automation solutions that help warehouses, production environments and distribution centers operate more efficiently.

Jobomschrijving

For an internationally active company specialized in automated warehouse systems and logistics automation, we are looking for an experienced and motivated Automation Technician / PLC Technician to join the permanent night shift team.

You will ensure that highly automated warehouse and logistics systems continue to operate efficiently and reliably.

As an Automation Technician, you will be responsible for the maintenance, troubleshooting and repair of automated installations.

Your responsibilities:

• Performing preventive and corrective maintenance on complex automated installations.
• Diagnosing and resolving technical faults and breakdowns.
• Troubleshooting issues in electrical, mechanical and automated systems.
• Working with PLC controls, sensors, motors and SCADA systems.
• Ensuring that automated warehouse installations operate safely and efficiently.
• Carrying out technical interventions independently and identifying the root cause of malfunctions.
• Recording maintenance activities and interventions correctly in the CMMS system (Sprocket).
• Working independently during the permanent night shift, while consulting colleagues when necessary.
• Contributing to the safety, reliability and efficiency of the installations.

• A technical degree in electromechanics, electricity, automation and/or mechanics.
• Several years of experience as an Automation Technician, Maintenance Technician, Service Technician, Troubleshooting Technician or PLC Technician.
• Basic knowledge of industrial automation and PLC systems.
• Knowledge of sensors, motors, electrical components and technical installations.
• Experience with or an interest in SCADA and CMMS systems.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• A proactive, independent and accurate working attitude.
• A good command of Dutch and/or English.
• No fear of heights, as you may work at different levels within the automated installations.
• Good physical fitness.
• A strong interest in technology and a willingness to continue learning.
• The flexibility and motivation to work in 2 shifts

Join our team as a Warehouse & Operations Associate and contribute to a mission that truly makes a difference in the fight against life-threatening diseases such as bloodcancer. 
 

In this role, you will be part of a supportive and collaborative environment within a leading global pharmaceutical company.
 

As a Warehouse & Operations Associate, your responsibilities will primarily focus on operational warehouse activities with an accurate administrative follow-up. 
 

 
• Responsible for inbound and outbound warehouse activities in a GMP-regulated environment.
 
• Receive, handle and store cryopreserved blood samples (cells) from cancer patients, which serve as the critical starting material for the manufacturing process.
 
• Manage inventory, warehouse materials and internal material requests to support other departments.
 
• Use SAP to process warehouse transactions and ensure accurate inventory records.
 
• Maintain documentation, traceability and compliance with GMP and quality requirements.
 
• Collaborate closely with other departments to support smooth day-to-day activities. 

 
• You have experience in logistics, warehousing, or operational environments, or you are eager to learn and develop yourself in this field.
 
• You work accurately, pay close attention to detail, and follow procedures to ensure quality, compliance, and safety.
 
• You are reliable, proactive, and take ownership of your responsibilities.
 
• You enjoy working in a team and collaborate effectively with colleagues across different departments.
 
• You communicate fluently in English, both verbally and in writing.
 
• You can commute independently to the site and are comfortable working in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.

Responsibilities

• Translate architectural standards and business needs into concrete functional and technical requirements for data flows.
• Define data definitions and KPIs within a semantic layer to ensure consistent reporting across the organization.
• Implement and automate data quality rules to detect and resolve inconsistencies in completeness and accuracy.
• Develop and maintain ETL/ELT processes to provide a reliable publication layer for various business intelligence tools.
• Set up and manage CI/CD pipelines for data models and reports to ensure controlled releases.
• Monitor batch processes and data loads while ensuring compliance with data governance and security policies.

Requirements

• You bring 5+ years of experience in data engineering, data warehousing, or business intelligence.
• You possess 2+ years of experience working in a development team utilizing CI/CD workflows.
• You have expert-level knowledge of SQL and data modeling methodologies such as Kimball, Data Vault, and SCD.
• You have experience with ETL/ELT processes and batch processing.
• You're proficient with version control and CI/CD tools including Git, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, or GitLab CI.
• You possess knowledge of BI tools and semantic layers such as Power BI, SAS Visual Analytics, or Apache Superset.
• You bring experience with data quality and testing automation using tools like dbt tests.
• You have experience working with Jira or Azure Boards.
• You're analytical, accurate, and proactive within complex environments.
• You are fluent in Dutch or French with functional English and a passive understanding of the other national language.
Nice to Haves

• Certifications such as DAMA CDMP, Azure Data Engineer, or Databricks.
• Experience with Python, dbt, Docker, or Azure.
• Knowledge of SAS 9.4, including Base SAS, Enterprise Guide, and DI Studio.
• Previous experience working within a public sector organization.

Our client is a leading international industrial group with operations across multiple continents and an ambitious growth strategy driven by innovation and strategic investments.To strengthen its specialist M&A Legal team, the organisation is looking to appoint a Senior Legal Counsel based in Brussels.

Jobomschrijving

As Senior Legal Counsel - M&A, you will act as lead legal adviser on high-profile international transactions.Your responsibilities will include:

• Leading the legal execution of domestic and international acquisitions, divestitures, joint ventures and strategic investments.
• Managing complex legal due diligence exercises and coordinating specialist legal input across multiple jurisdictions.
• Drafting, reviewing and negotiating transaction documentation, including share purchase agreements, joint venture agreements, transition service agreements, NDAs and other ancillary documents.
• Advising on transaction structuring and identifying pragmatic solutions to legal and commercial risks.
• Partnering with internal stakeholders across Corporate Strategy, M&A, Finance, Treasury, Tax, HR, IT and Compliance throughout the deal lifecycle.
• Managing signing, closing and post-closing processes.
• Supporting integrations, carve-outs and corporate reorganisations following completed transactions.
• Coordinating and managing external legal counsel internationally while maintaining ownership of transaction execution.
• Advising senior management on strategic legal considerations impacting investment decisions.
• Contributing to the continuous development of the company's M&A legal function and best practices.

• Belgian Master's degree in Law.
• Approximately 8  years of post-qualification experience in Corporate/M&A law.
• Experience gained within a leading international law firm and/or a sophisticated international in-house legal environment.
• Demonstrated experience leading complex domestic and cross-border M&A transactions.
• Excellent drafting, negotiation and project management skills.
• Strong commercial judgement and ability to translate legal complexity into practical business advice.
• Confident communicator with the ability to influence senior stakeholders.
• Fluent in English. French and/or Dutch are considered strong assets.
